instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and salt; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb lean ground beef
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato paste, Worcestershire, and spices to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tomato paste
2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, water, and pasta to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until macaroni is cooked through, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cups chicken or vegetable broth
16 oz macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is almost done, preheat oven to broil on high and arrange rack in the upper third of the oven.

When the pasta is done, add 1 ½ cups cheese to the skillet and stir to combine. Top skillet with remaining cheese, place in the oven, and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide macaroni casserole between plates and enjoy!
